items.title: Le'Trice Donaldson, "Duty Beyond the Battlefield" : CSPAN3 : October 28, 2022 1:25pm-2:26pm EDT
items.description:
Author & professor Le'Trice Donaldson detailed how Black soldiers between the Civil War and World War I used their military service to further civil rights. The World War I Museum in Kansas City, Missouri, hosted this event.

Sponsor: National World War I Museum and Memorial

items.title: They fought for us. Now, we fight for them. A team of world-renowned doctors has come to Israel to provide the highest level of care to our wounded warriors—those who gave everything to defend our home.  Among them is Alon Kimner, a soldier whose courage extends far beyond the battlefield. His journey of resilience, recovery, and advocacy is nothing short of inspiring. He stands as a beacon of hope for others walking the same path.  🎥 @brothers.forlife
